pages.text: The Growth Accelerator massively accelerates $(l:ae2_mechanics/certus_growth)the growth of$(/l) certus or amethyst when placed adjacent to the budding block.$(br2)Curiously, it can $(o)also$() accelerate the growth of various plants.$(br2)It does this by applying "random ticks" to the adjacent
blocks, in addition to the random ticks that happen naturally. In theory this means 1 accelerator should make things grow ~90x faster than normal, and the effect stacks additively.
Power can be provided via the top or bottom, via either AE2's $(l:items_blocks_machines/cables)cables$(/l), or other mod power

cables. It can accept either AE2's power (AE) or Forge Energy (FE).$(br2)To power it manually, place a $(l:items_blocks_machines/crank)Wooden Crank$(/l) on the top or bottom and right-click it.$(br2)The top and the bottom can be identified by the pink flux greebles on them.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()
